strategic_conclusion.answer: Measured implementation candidates account for 24.60% of ordinary dual-lane wall time, enough for one architecture-level investigation but not a broad new series of micro-optimizations. The three lifecycle micro-candidates together are only 3.60%; the material implementation surface is transport/representation. Most remaining cost is inherent Rust SSA or deliberate shadow/safety/comparison policy.
